title: A TORN CHRONICLE
description:
A burnt page on a moss-eaten lectern. You can make out three lines:

  "...the goblin tide came at dusk. The
  gates held until dawn. King Ennor stood
  alone in the vault — and they took the
  crown from his hand."

The rest is ash.

outcomes.text: You fold the page into your robe. A scholar somewhere will pay.
You walk on. The wind takes the ash.

title: HERMIT'S TALE
description:
An old man tends a small fire at the trail's edge. He watches you pass, then speaks without looking up:

  "Quiet folk, the goblins, before.
  Tribute every harvest, no trouble.
  Then one summer — they marched.
  Took the crown straight off the throne.
  Went into the bones of the kingdom.
  My grandfather saw it. Never spoke
  of it twice."

outcomes.text: You sit a while. The fire takes the ache out of your bones.
You nod and walk on. The hermit does not look up.

title: A CHILD'S SONG
description:
Carved into a wayside stone, half-eaten by lichen. A spirit at the edge of sight hums the rhyme as you read:

  sing-a-song of the crimson worm
  under the hill where the king's
    bones turn
  gold is gold and the gold is bright
  the crown lies under, out of sight

The spirit fades.

outcomes.text: The rhyme settles in you. Something steadies.
You walk past. The humming follows for a few steps, then doesn't.

title: WAYSIDE ALTAR
description: A roadside altar of old Eldarmark, half-toppled. The stag-and-tower sigil still shows under the moss. Offerings have lain here a long time.

outcomes.text: Light, faint and warm. The dead kings answer kindly.
The stone is cold. Something old turns toward you and takes notice.
You pry up the offerings. Something cuts you on the way out.
You step around it.

title: A CHEST IN THE PATH
description:
An iron-bound chest, alone on the path. No tracks lead to it.

It seems too easy.

outcomes.text: Coins. A small jeweled charm. Whoever left this is long gone.
The lid snaps. A spring-blade catches your forearm before you can pull back.
You walk wide of it. The forest swallows the chest behind you.

title: A HUNGRY GHOST
description:
A faint figure in tattered clothes blocks the path. The face flickers between many — a farmer, a soldier, a child. One of the kingdom's dead, still walking.

It raises a thin hand toward you.

outcomes.text: The spirit's hand passes through your chest. It leaves warmth where the cold was.
Cold floods you. The ghost was hungry, not kind.
You speak the old words. The figure thins, then is not there.
You step around it. It does not follow.

title: CORRUPTED TERMINAL
description: Half-decoded process logs hover on the screen. You could try to decompile them — at a cost.

outcomes.text: Sparks. The terminal yields a token.
You step back. The flicker continues.

title: BACKDOOR
description: An unauthorised port hangs open. Could be a trap, could be a shortcut.

outcomes.text: The port accepts. You slip in.
Trap. Trace logged.
You step back.

title: GHOST USER
description: Another summoner's stale session bleeds through. They left mana behind.

outcomes.text: You absorb the trace. Power steadies.
You wipe the trace. Silence.
